messages:
maria: PTAL — I pushed a follow-up to #4567 that addresses the review comments. Main changes: added a rollback guard, split the large integration test into two smaller ones, and fixed a docstring typo. Wanted to call out CI: gpu-smoke is failing intermittently (seems unrelated) and the fips-matrix job failed with an OpenSSL mismatch.

alex: looking now. thanks for splitting the tests, much easier to read. quick q: did you keep the previous behavior for zero-sized batches?

maria: yes, behavior preserved. I added a small unit test: `test_zero_batch_passthrough` in runtime/batching_test.py.

jordan: re: FIPS, last week the CI image bumped openssl->3.1 and some tests started failing. fips-matrix is noisy; we usually ignore it for non-security PRs unless it's a regression.

maria: ok, good to know. I'll file a follow-up to track the fips mismatch if it keeps failing. For merge: can someone volunteer to be merge custodian? I'd like to land this in the next merge window (tomorrow morning).

sam: I can take merge custodian if CI stabilizes. I'll watch for swagger and canary slot. :+1:

alex: if sam is on, I'm happy to give an extra approver. Two approvals and green CI fine by me.

maria: thanks @sam and @alex — I addressed Alex's nits in the last commit, squashed into one. I've left the changelog entry as a separate commit (prefer not to squash that).

ci-bot: ci/status gpu-smoke — failed on job 4821 — transient GPU OOM in test_integration_shard; retry queued.

ci-bot: ci/status fips-matrix — failed on job 1210 — OpenSSL version mismatch (libssl.so.3 vs libcrypto.so.1.1).

sam: noted. I'll wait for a retry on gpu-smoke; if that passes and unit/coverage are green, I'll merge. If fips-matrix continues to fail I'll annotate the PR and create a tracking ticket.

maria: awesome, thanks. PTAL (again) @sam @alex — comments addressed and tests added. pinging the release ops calendar for tomorrow's merges.

alex: LGTM from me. :rocket:

sam: LGTM and merging once gpu-smoke retry passes. I'll set a canary for 9:30am PT.

maria: thank you both! I'll open a short follow-up issue to track the fips-matrix image pin.
